description: Lists a page of legacy usage record summaries for a subscription item across billing periods, with cursor pagination. DEPRECATED: Stripe removed this endpoint in Basil; legacy usage requires a pre-Basil API version. Migrate to Stripe meters for usage-based billing.

ending_before.description: A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.
starting_after.title: Starting After

subscription_item.description: The ID of the subscription item whose usage record summaries to retrieve.
subscription_item.title: Subscription Item

name: list_all_subscription_item_period_summaries

data.description: An array containing the actual response elements (usage record summary objects), paginated by any request parameters.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: Whether or not there are more elements available after this set.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'list'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL for accessing this list.
url.title: Url

end.description: Unix timestamp representing the end of the usage period (inclusive). Can be null if the period is ongoing.
end.title: End

start.description: Unix timestamp representing the beginning of the usage period.
start.title: Start

id.description: Unique identifier for the usage record summary object.
id.title: Id

invoice.description: The invoice in which this usage period has been billed for. If the usage period has not been billed yet, this field will be null.
invoice.title: Invoice

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'usage_record_summary'.
object.title: Object

period.description: Start and end dates of this usage period.
period.title: Period

subscription_item.description: The ID of the subscription item this summary is describing.
subscription_item.title: Subscription Item

total_usage.description: The total usage within this usage period.
total_usage.title: Total Usage
